# etok.me

> Personal site of Ethan Davidson (EthanThatOneKid): software engineer, music-production educator, and community builder.

## Pages

- [Home](https://etok.me/): Ethan Davidson, software engineer and community builder.
- [Blog](https://etok.me/blog/): Posts by Ethan Davidson.
- [Hello World](https://etok.me/blog/hello-world/) (2026-10-01): Welcome to the new blog on etok.me.

## Projects

- [gfmpreview](https://ethanthatonekid.github.io/gfmpreview): Static JS markdown preview, live on GitHub Pages.
- Holosuite: Prompt-to-playable-program holodeck (Cal Hacks 12 origin; v1 rebuild in progress, not yet live).

## Machine interface

- [For agents](https://etok.me/for-agents/): Machine-readable front door for this site. Static files only; no API endpoint yet, no user accounts, no credentials, no commerce surface.
